barstate.isConfirmed: boolean

The current bar's last block is finalized.

### barstate.isFirst {#barstate-isfirst}

```ts
barstate.isFirst: boolean
```

The current bar is the first bar of the run.

### barstate.isLast {#barstate-islast}

```ts
barstate.isLast: boolean
```

The current bar is the newest the runtime has received (true while each bar is processed).

### barstate.isRealtime {#barstate-isrealtime}

```ts
barstate.isRealtime: boolean
```

false while the runtime replays history; true for bars and blocks that arrive live after the replay. Always false in a backtest.

### barstate.index {#barstate-index}

```ts
barstate.index: number
```

Index of the current bar, from 0.
